#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path


SCAN_EXTENSIONS = {
    ".rs",
    ".py",
    ".js",
    ".ts",
    ".jsx",
    ".tsx",
    ".go",
    ".c",
    ".cpp",
    ".h",
    ".java",
    ".rb",
    ".lua",
    ".hs",
    ".sql",
    ".tf",
    ".sh",
    ".ps1",
    ".yml",
    ".yaml",
    ".toml",
    ".json",
    ".md",
    ".css",
    ".html",
}

EXCLUDED_DIRS = {".git", "node_modules", "target"}

KEYWORD = "TO" + "DO"
REPORT_NAME = KEYWORD + "_AUDIT.md"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Finding:
    file_path: str
    line_number: int
    description: str
    estimated_hours: int


def repo_root() -> Path:
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def should_skip(path: Path) -> bool:
    return any(part in EXCLUDED_DIRS for part in path.parts)


def is_probably_binary(data: bytes) -> bool:
    if b"\x00" in data:
        return True

    sample = data[:4096]
    if not sample:
        return False

    text_chars = bytearray({7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 27})
    text_chars.extend(range(0x20, 0x100))
    non_text = sample.translate(None, bytes(text_chars))
    return len(non_text) / max(len(sample), 1) > 0.30


def read_text(path: Path) -> str | None:
    try:
        data = path.read_bytes()
    except OSError:
        return None

    if is_probably_binary(data):
        return None

    for encoding in ("utf-8", "utf-8-sig", "latin-1"):
        try:
            return data.decode(encoding)
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue

    return None


def iter_code_files(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    files: list[Path] = []

    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        if should_skip(path):
            continue

        if not path.is_file():
            continue

        if path.suffix.lower() not in SCAN_EXTENSIONS:
            continue

        files.append(path)

    return sorted(files)


def relative_path(path: Path, root: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        return path.as_posix()


def collect_findings(root: Path) -> list[Finding]:
    findings: list[Finding] = []
    needle = KEYWORD.lower()

    for path in iter_code_files(root):
        text = read_text(path)
        if text is None:
            continue

        rel_path = relative_path(path, root)

        for line_number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
            if needle not in line.lower():
                continue

            estimated_hours = (line_number % 7) + 1
            findings.append(
                Finding(
                    file_path=rel_path,
                    line_number=line_number,
                    description=line.strip(),
                    estimated_hours=estimated_hours,
                )
            )

    return sorted(
        findings,
        key=lambda item: (
            -item.estimated_hours,
            item.file_path.lower(),
            item.line_number,
        ),
    )


def escape_markdown_cell(value: object) -> str:
    text = str(value)
    text = text.replace("\\", "\\\\")
    text = text.replace("|", "\\|")
    text = text.replace("\n", " ")
    return text


def build_summary(findings: list[Finding]) -> list[str]:
    total_count = len(findings)
    total_hours = sum(item.estimated_hours for item in findings)
    file_count = len({item.file_path for item in findings})

    lines = [
        "## 统计摘要",
        "",
        "| 指标 | 数值 |",
        "| --- | ---: |",
        f"| 扫描命中项总数 | {total_count} |",
        f"| 涉及文件数 | {file_count} |",
        f"| 预估总修复时间 | {total_hours} 小时 |",
        "",
    ]

    by_hour: dict[int, int] = {}
    for item in findings:
        by_hour[item.estimated_hours] = by_hour.get(item.estimated_hours, 0) + 1

    lines.extend(
        [
            "## 按预估时间分布",
            "",
            "| 预估修复时间 | 数量 |",
            "| ---: | ---: |",
        ]
    )

    for hour in sorted(by_hour, reverse=True):
        lines.append(f"| {hour} 小时 | {by_hour[hour]} |")

    lines.append("")
    return lines


def build_detail_table(findings: list[Finding]) -> list[str]:
    lines = [
        "## 明细",
        "",
        "| 文件 | 行号 | 描述 | 预估修复时间 |",
        "| --- | ---: | --- | ---: |",
    ]

    for item in findings:
        lines.append(
            "| "
            + escape_markdown_cell(item.file_path)
            + " | "
            + str(item.line_number)
            + " | "
            + escape_markdown_cell(item.description)
            + " | "
            + str(item.estimated_hours)
            + " 小时 |"
        )

    lines.append("")
    return lines


def build_report(findings: list[Finding]) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"# {KEYWORD} Audit Report",
        "",
        f"本报告由 `tools/generate_todo_audit.py` 自动生成。",
        "",
        "扫描规则：",
        "",
        f"- 搜索关键字：`{KEYWORD}`，大小写不敏感。",
        "- 扫描范围：指定代码与配置文件扩展名。",
        "- 排除目录：`.git`、`node_modules`、`target`。",
        "- 预估公式：`(line_number % 7) + 1` 小时。",
        "- 排序规则：按预估修复时间降序排列。",
        "",
    ]

    lines.extend(build_summary(findings))
    lines.extend(build_detail_table(findings))

    if not findings:
        lines.extend(
            [
                "## 结论",
                "",
                f"未发现 `{KEYWORD}` 记录。",
                "",
            ]
        )

    return "\n".join(lines)


def write_report(root: Path, report: str) -> Path:
    report_path = root / REPORT_NAME
    report_path.write_text(report, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    return report_path


def main() -> int:
    root = repo_root()
    findings = collect_findings(root)
    report = build_report(findings)
    report_path = write_report(root, report)

    print(f"Generated {relative_path(report_path, root)}")
    print(f"Findings: {len(findings)}")
    print(f"Estimated hours: {sum(item.estimated_hours for item in findings)}")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
